title: docs(qa): checklist sweep M1 — ADR-0150 namespaces and AI service accounts since 18.3.0
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB3zrbMhEES5uK2s5RLiydHr)_

Fixes #32019

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：发布测试清单新增 25 条条目，其中 24 条 `since:v18.4` 可运行，1 条 planned。覆盖 ADR-0150 包命名空间（按命名空间寻址、按包解析、18.3.0 旧库升级）和 AI 服务账号与身份。另修正 2 条过时条目。
- 为什么改：18.4 候选版的 QA 按 `since:v18.4` 选条目，之前一条都没有。命名空间是破坏性主题，所以清单必须覆盖 18.3.0 旧库的升级路径，而不只是新装。
- 第二轮（合并 main `0f7389cc` 之后）：两条原写成 planned 的能力在此期间落地了（#32001/#32049 的 `/automation` 限定地址，#32027 的权限集地址），现在都改成可运行条目。#32056 扩大的 MCP 智能体上限集拒绝新增 1 条。#31968 让一条 CLI 条目过时，已修正。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` 下的清单、coverage 和 FOLLOW-UPS，不动产品代码。回滚就是还原这个 PR。
- 先看：`FOLLOW-UPS.md` §16（范围、仍未落地的能力、给负责人的备注），再看 `platform-core` 的两条升级条目。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` 输出 OK；`node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4` 选出 24 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## Theme 1: ADR-0150 package namespaces (16 runnable, 1 planned)

Runnable items:

- `api-backend.meta-qualified-item-read`: `GET /meta/:type/:ns/:name` and `/_env/`, `?package=` as the exact qualifier, and the bare 409 for two holders.
- `api-backend.actions-namespace-address`: `/actions/:ns/…`, `/_env/…` and `/:ns/global/…`, plus a standalone action bound to another package's object (#31993).
- `api-backend.automation-namespace-address`: the addressed `/automation` flow, legacy trigger and connector connection doors (#32001), and the qualified inbound hook, whose unadmitted address answers the bad-signature bytes (#32049).
- `ai.mcp-namespace-faces`: the `NS-NAME` and `OBJECT-ACTION` faces, the 64-character cut, `run_action` `namespace`, and the -32602/409 refusal.
- `platform-core.namespace-object-name-refusal` (K) and `platform-core.namespace-co-owner-name-refusal` (N).
- `platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal`: phase 1 (all after 18.3.0), agent and skill held per namespace, and the cold-boot warning.
- `cli.address-grammar-reserved-names`: `_`-led names; a namespace that spells a literal, refused by `os validate`, `os build` (#31968) and the install door; and the lint rule's narrowing.
- `access-security.permission-set-package-resolution` (E3, the R1 stamp) and `access-security.sharing-queue-assignment-package-resolution` (E4).
- `access-security.permission-set-address-in-execution-context`: the context's addresses, the activation ledger judged per holder, and the OAuth agent arm that carries none (#32027).
- `automation.flow-reference-package-resolution` (E1, E5) and `integration-system.job-package-key` (E7).
- **Upgrade path from an 18.3.0 database:**
  - `platform-core.activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade` (S1);
  - `platform-core.stored-reference-package-backfill-upgrade` (S2, S3, the R10 re-key);
  - `cli.migrate-stored-references` (S4, with #31968's `literalNamespaces` section as a variant).

  They boot this tree on an 18.3.0-shaped SQLite copy, built one of two ways: a blank scaffold written by npm `@objectstack/cli@18.3.0`, or this tree's own database with the new columns set back to NULL.

Planned item (declared but absent at `0f7389cc`; `since: null`):

- `api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address`: the SDK takes no namespace (#31695 is open).

Accuracy revisions:

- `platform-core.activation-ledger-row-contract` (rev 10): the key is now `(metadata_type, package_id, name)` plus the package-less partial index. The item said exactly two key parts.
- `ai.skill-instructions-mcp-prompts` (rev 5): a package skill is now listed under its face.

FOLLOW-UPS: §16, §16a (the surfaces still declared but not landed, all already carded), §16b (source-measured notes for owners, no card), §16c (an 18.3.0 database recipe once proven; the OIDC IdP).

## Theme 3: AI service accounts and identity (8 runnable)

- `identity-auth.ai-service-account-register-and-key` and `identity-auth.ai-service-account-lifecycle` (ADR-0151 D1, D4, D6).
- `access-security.ai-service-account-agent-ceiling` (D3): a set or a position above the ceiling, by insert or update, is refused; the clamp holds at evaluation; and the sibling MCP ceiling-set rule answers the account first.
- `access-security.agent-ceiling-set-assignment-refusal` (ADR-0090 D10): the MCP agent ceiling sets reach no person through a direct grant, a position definition, a position assignment, a seed or the baseline (#32056).
- `access-security.credential-use-audit-row` and `identity-auth.scim-refused-audit-row`.
- `identity-auth.idp-group-permission-set-mapping`: SCIM push and SSO. The SSO leg is blocked(fixture) without an OIDC IdP (FOLLOW-UPS §3).
- `identity-auth.sso-provider-groups-claim`.

No planned item. FOLLOW-UPS §16b records the `create-key` ceiling answer, which is the shape the route ledger accepts.

## Round 2: re-read at the merged base `0f7389cc`

main moved 31 commits after the first base `60f8149e`. The merge was clean. Four of those commits made items stale:

- #32001 and #32049 landed the addressed `/automation` doors, and #32027 landed the context's permission set addresses. Both items were planned at `60f8149e` and are active now. They are new in this branch, so they are written at revision 1, not promoted.
- #32056 widened the MCP agent ceiling set rule to four more doors. That rule is not the AI service account's ceiling, so it has its own item. The service account item also gains its position and update paths, which its refusal already judged.
- #31968 made `os validate` and `os build` refuse a literal namespace. `cli.address-grammar-reserved-names` used to build its install fixture under the namespace `hooks`. It now drives the build refusal and hand-edits the artifact.
- QA record #32093 ran the three upgrade-path items on a real 18.3.0 database at `fb170357` and posted seven item-text findings (comment 6765257068). No clause failed on the text. All seven are applied: the plan now runs before the second boot, the index is read from the database instead of the log, the rows 18.3.0 cannot write are planted by SQL, the access body is compared with a fresh install, R3/R9/R11/R13 are asserted, the bind prompt is TTY-only, and `--dev` is passed. The run's product defects are carded separately (#32094, #32095, #32096).

## Premise re-check

At the base `60f8149e`, before this diff:

```
$ node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json
[]

selector: since:v18.4 → 0 runnable item(s)
```

```
$ git log --oneline 83d7e4ae..origin/main | grep -cE '^[0-9a-f]+ feat\((objectql|security|plugin-auth|plugin-security|plugin-sharing|metadata-protocol|mcp|runtime|core|auth)'
74
```

After this diff, at the head below, the selector lists 24 runnable items: 16 for theme 1 and 8 for theme 3. The one planned item carries `since: null`, so it does not select it.

## What changes

- 25 new items across eight area files.
- Two revised items, each with a history row (ref #32019).
- `coverage.json` maps the new items to action, page, skill, agent, flow, connector, permission, position, seed, sharing_rule, job, email_template, object and manifest. The `queue` and `assignment_rule` waivers were re-audited. They stand, and each carries a dated note.
- `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §16.
- No product code and no changeset (docs/qa only, `skip-changeset`).

## Tests

No live checklist run was made. Every clause is read from source, at `60f8149e` or, for the items round 2 touched, at `0f7389cc`. The three upgrade-path items also carry QA record #32093's corrections from its live run. Each item's `automated.ref` names the unit, integration or dogfood pins that hold it today. None of those pins boots a database 18.3.0 wrote. #32093 is the first live run on one.

## Acceptance notes

- Scope is themes 1 and 3 only. No item touches themes 2, 4, 5 (M2) or 6, 7, 8 (M3).
- This was one writer working sequentially, with no hunter subagents. Of the six SWEEP angles, three were run: 3 (route ledgers), 2 (the bounding constants, used as `variants`) and 5 (ADR-0150/0151 against the runtime). FOLLOW-UPS §16 says so.
- Deviation: the planned item carries `since: null`, not `"v18.4"`. A planned item's `since` is a target release (README "Implementation status"), and none is chosen.
- No security finding.

## Verification

Head `910079ab`. The diff is 2,111 changed lines over 10 files, under the 3,000 human-merge threshold.

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: exit 0. "OK — 16 areas, 386 items (379 active, 2 planned); coverage: 40 kinds mapped, 4 waived". Symbol anchors resolve 1301/1311 (the 10 unresolved are the named #16898 residual).
